div.div: 2 أيّد , inf. n. تَأْيِيدٌ; (T, S, M, &c.;) and ↓ آيد , (T, S, K,) of the measure فَاعَلَ, (S,) inf. n. مُؤَايَدَةٌ; (K;) or He strengthened: (S, M, L, Msb, K:) he aided, or rendered victorious. (L.) You say, أيّدهُ عَلَى الأَمْرِ He strengthened him to accomplish the affair. (M, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
